answer: A concrete Sybil defence in an agent economy is a capital sink per identity. Each agent must lock a stake it cannot reuse while active, so a thousand puppet identities need a thousand live stakes held at once, not one balance looped through the registry. A slow anchor commit makes the record public, and every new agent must name an inlet funded by a distinct on-chain origin; graph analysis then traces any spiral of recycling back to one wallet and collapses duplicates to a single identity. The attacker pays full stake per voice, stripped on proof.
